text:
Meghan Markle has left royal fans reeling (stock image)(Image: Suzanne Cordeiro/Getty Images)

Meghan Markle has left royal fans reeling after making what people have deemed a "disrespectful" move, and some appear to be dumbfounded. It's come after the Duchess of Sussex released a new video via the As Ever Official Instagram page, which is her lifestyle brand, and people were quick to spot something in particular.

In the video, Meghan Markle is seen walking up a path while holding a bottle of wine. It was shared alongside the caption: "For gathering all summer long. Refreshing Sauvignon Blanc. Celebratory Brut. Light and bright Rosé."

However, even though all eyes should have been on the product, people were distracted by something else entirely. It comes after the palace were said to be facing a Prince Harry and Meghan "conundrum".

On X, Nancy Sidley wrote: "Meghan Markle wants the world to know she’s DONE with that c***** a** engagement ring Harry gave her. Princess Diana’s tiny diamonds are not cutting it anymore."

When you view the footage, you'll notice that Meghan is only wearing her wedding ring, and her diamond engagement ring is not in sight. While there may be a reason behind it, the move certainly got a lot of people talking.

One replied: "I’ve been waiting to see what she’s done with it 'this time'. She hasn’t worn it in months."

Another added: "Ungrateful." A third replied: "Oh wow. The ring is missing. Interesting."

Meanwhile, a fourth commented: "So silly." Elsewhere, someone else also noted: "Ungrateful, and disrespectful from the very beginning!!"

Warning: Below post contains language some may find offensive

However, some did think it was up to her whether she wore the ring or not, and others praised her. The video has certainly sparked debate.

A different person said: "Men have to stop surprising women with engagement rings. Shop together."

Another noted: "My darling Meghan looking absolutely stunning. I adore her in white." One more also stated: "She is amazing."

When it comes to the ring itself, it's said there is a touching story behind it. The original ring is reported to have featured a central diamond from Botswana, which is a place the couple cherish, and is flanked by two diamonds believed to be from one of Princess Diana’s tennis bracelets.

The nod to Diana was thought to be rather "touching", while the Botswana centre stone works to symbolise the couple’s shared love for Africa. However, it's said Meghan has made some tweaks to the ring over the years.

Reports claim Meghan has altered and added to her engagement ring at least three times since 2017. It's claimed these tweaks tend to mirror major events and changes in her life.
